oedo-antique-market-tokyo-international-.name: Oedo Antique Market (Tokyo International Forum)
oedo-antique-market-tokyo-international-.time: 9:00–16:00 (may end earlier depending on the weather or other events)
oedo-antique-market-tokyo-international-.rule: Twice a month (dates are announced in the official event schedule)
oedo-antique-market-tokyo-international-.rain: Cancelled in rain (cancelled if the forecast issued at 17:00 the day before gives a precipitation probability of 80% or more for the Tokyo area from 6:00 to 12:00; otherwise the secretariat decides)
oedo-antique-market-tokyo-international-.access: In front of JR Yurakucho Station
oedo-antique-market-tokyo-international-.fee: 12,000 yen per booth (half booth 8,000 yen, 1.5 booths 14,000 yen, 2 booths 17,000 yen). Collected on the day
oedo-antique-market-tokyo-international-.apply: Application form set by the secretariat (from the 2nd time, by phone, fax or e-mail). There is a screening
oedo-antique-market-tokyo-international-.notes: For those who sell antiques. You must carry a second-hand dealer’s license (the type that includes the peddling clause)

takahata-fudoson-gozareichi.name: Takahata Fudoson Gozare-ichi (Garakuta Market)
takahata-fudoson-gozareichi.access: 5 min. on foot from Takahata-Fudo Station (Keio Line / Tama Monorail)

takahata-fudoson-recycle-market.name: Takahata Fudoson Recycle Market (Flea Market)
takahata-fudoson-recycle-market.access: 5 min. on foot from Takahata-Fudo Station (Keio Line / Tama Monorail)

tokyo-nominoichi-2026-autumn.name: Tokyo Nominoichi ’26 AUTUMN
tokyo-nominoichi-2026-autumn.venue: Showa Kinen Park, Midori no Bunka Zone, Yume-hiroba
tokyo-nominoichi-2026-autumn.admission: Advance ticket 1,800 yen / day ticket 2,300 yen (tax included; free for junior high school students and younger, who must be accompanied by a guardian)
tokyo-nominoichi-2026-autumn.rain: Held in rain, except in severe weather (if cancelled, announced on the official site and social media by 7:00 on the day)
tokyo-nominoichi-2026-autumn.access: 10 min. on foot from Tachikawa Station (JR Chuo Line) / 8 min. from Tachikawa-Kita Station (Tama Monorail) / 1 min. on foot from Akebono Gate of Showa Kinen Park

zoshigaya-tezukuriichi.name: Zoshigaya Tezukuri-ichi (Handmade Market)
zoshigaya-tezukuriichi.rule: Basically the 3rd Sunday (may shift depending on the temple’s events). Dates are announced in the official schedule
zoshigaya-tezukuriichi.rain: Cancelled in rain (whether it is held or cancelled is announced on X and the blog by 7:00 on the day)
zoshigaya-tezukuriichi.access: 5 min. on foot from Zoshigaya Station (Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line) / 5 min. from Kishimojin-mae Station (Toden Arakawa Line)
zoshigaya-tezukuriichi.fee: 3,000 yen per day (1 booth is about 1.8 m × 1.8 m, up to 2 people)
zoshigaya-tezukuriichi.apply: Send the application form by post (an application period is set for each event; exhibitors are to be announced within 1 week after the deadline)

setagaya-boroichi.name: Setagaya Boro-ichi
setagaya-boroichi.venue: Boro-ichi Street and the surrounding area
setagaya-boroichi.rule: 4 days every year: Dec 15 and 16, and Jan 15 and 16
setagaya-boroichi.rain: May be cancelled in severe weather (changes and cancellations are announced on the ward website and on the X account of the Setagaya General Branch Office)
setagaya-boroichi.access: 3 min. on foot from Setagaya and Kamimachi stations (Tokyu Setagaya Line)

setagaya-park-flea.name: Setagaya Park Flea Market
setagaya-park-flea.rule: Dates announced by Setagaya Ward (Oct 2026 – Mar 2027). No events in July and August
setagaya-park-flea.rain: Whether it is held on the day: ask each organizing group (per the ward’s notice)
setagaya-park-flea.access: 18 min walk from Ikejiri-Ohashi Station (Tokyu Den-en-toshi Line) / 18 min walk from Sangenjaya Station (Tokyu Setagaya Line / Den-en-toshi Line)

toji-kobo-ichi.name: To-ji Kobo-ichi market
toji-kobo-ichi.access: 15 min. on foot from the Hachijo exit of Kyoto Station / 10 min. from Toji Station

kitano-tenjin-ennichi.name: Kitano Tenmangu “Tenjin-san” (monthly fair on the 25th)
kitano-tenjin-ennichi.time: Stalls are open all day (the grounds are lit up from sunset)
kitano-tenjin-ennichi.access: About 5 min on foot from Kitano-Hakubaicho Station (Keifuku Electric Railway). The nearest Kyoto City Bus stop is Kitano Tenmangu-mae. The official site says the worshippers' parking lot is not available on the 25th of each month.

shitennoji-daishie.name: Shitennoji Daishi-e (monthly on the 21st, “Odaishi-san”)
shitennoji-daishie.access: About 5 min on foot from Shitennoji-mae Yuhigaoka Station (Osaka Metro Tanimachi Line).
shitennoji-daishie.admission: The central temple precinct is open free of charge on this day (the top-floor gallery of the five-story pagoda is also open)

sapporo-nakajima-park-flea.name: Nakajima Park Flea Market (Sapporo)
sapporo-nakajima-park-flea.rule: Dates for fiscal 2026 announced by Sapporo City (see the city’s list)
sapporo-nakajima-park-flea.rain: May be cancelled depending on the weather (ask each organizing group for the status)
sapporo-nakajima-park-flea.access: Nearest stations are Nakajima-koen Station (exits 1 and 3) and Horohirabashi Station (exits 1 and 2) on the Sapporo Municipal Subway Namboku Line. From the streetcar stops Nakajima-koen-dori and Gyokei-dori it is a 3 min walk. The park has no parking lot of its own (walking time to the Jiyu Hiroba is not given).

shinjuku-recycle-center-flea.name: Shinjuku Recycle Activity Center Flea Market
shinjuku-recycle-center-flea.access: 3 min. on foot from Takadanobaba Station (JR, Seibu Shinjuku Line, Tokyo Metro Tozai Line)

mizuho-aozora-ichi.name: Mizuho Eco Park Flea Market “Mizuho Aozora-ichi”
mizuho-aozora-ichi.venue: Mizuho Eco Park, in front of the management building
mizuho-aozora-ichi.rule: Dates for fiscal 2026 announced by Mizuho Town (no events in July–August and January)
mizuho-aozora-ichi.apply: Apply by phone (first come, first served). A lottery is held at the reception on the day and a permit is issued
mizuho-aozora-ichi.notes: Only residents of the town can exhibit. Up to 40 spaces
mizuho-aozora-ichi.access: About 350 m from Hakonegasaki Station (JR Hachiko Line). The town's guide says it takes less than 5 minutes on foot.
mizuho-aozora-ichi.rain: Cancellation due to rain is decided on the morning of the event (call between 7:30 and 9:00 to check)

suginami-furima-in-takaido-2026-11.name: Flea Market in Takaido (Environmental Activity Promotion Center)

suginami-furima-in-takaido-2026-11.notes: Open to people who live or work in the ward (no business sellers). 8 spaces. The application deadline is Oct 20, 2026. Items: clothing, accessories and miscellaneous goods. Carrying items in or out by car is not possible
suginami-furima-in-takaido-2026-11.access: About 2 min on foot from Takaido Station (Keio Inokashira Line). Or take a Kanto Bus (routes Ogi 54 or Ogi 58) to Takaido Station and walk about 2 min.

edogawa-recycle-world-in-tobu-2026.name: The 36th Recycle World IN Tobu

edogawa-recycle-world-in-tobu-2026.notes: Open to residents of Edogawa Ward
edogawa-recycle-world-in-tobu-2026.access: 5 min walk from Mizue Station (Toei Shinjuku Line)

sumida-kinshi-park-flea.name: Kinshi Park Flea Market
sumida-kinshi-park-flea.rule: Schedule for fiscal 2026 announced by Sumida Ward

sumida-kinshi-park-flea.access: About 3 min on foot from Kinshicho Station (JR Sobu Line, Tokyo Metro Hanzomon Line).
sumida-kinshi-park-flea.apply: To sell, apply directly to the organizing group (as stated by Sumida Ward)

sumida-yokojikkawa-kinshicho-flea.name: Oyokogawa Shinsui Park, Kinshicho Event Plaza Flea Market
sumida-yokojikkawa-kinshicho-flea.venue: Oyokogawa Shinsui Park, Kinshicho Event Plaza
sumida-yokojikkawa-kinshicho-flea.rule: Schedule for fiscal 2026 announced by Sumida Ward (with rain dates)
sumida-yokojikkawa-kinshicho-flea.rain: Rain dates are available (listed in the entry for each date). Please refrain from parking on the street near the venue

The north end (Narihira-bashi) is a 10 min walk from Oshiage Station and a 5 min walk from Tokyo Skytree Station or Honjo-Azumabashi Station.
sumida-yokojikkawa-kinshicho-flea.apply: To sell, apply directly to the organizing group (as stated by Sumida Ward)

bunkyo-stage-eco-flea-2026-11.name: Stage Eco Flea Market (Bunkyo)

toshima-nakaikebukuro-park-flea-2026-12.name: Naka-Ikebukuro Park Flea Market
toshima-nakaikebukuro-park-flea-2026-12.admission: Free admission (a workshop corner and a handmade market are also held)

toshima-nakaikebukuro-park-flea-2026-12.notes: Open to everyone, inside or outside the ward
toshima-nakaikebukuro-park-flea-2026-12.access: About 4 min on foot from Exit 30 (east exit) of Ikebukuro Station (JR, Tokyo Metro, Seibu Ikebukuro Line, Tobu Tojo Line). From Exits 6 and 7 of Higashi-Ikebukuro Station (Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line), about 11 min on foot via an underground passage.

ota-tamagawa-eco-fair-2026.name: Tamagawa Cleaning Plant Environment Fair 2026 (with a flea market)
ota-tamagawa-eco-fair-2026.rain: Held even in rain (cancelled in severe weather). Please refrain from coming by car
ota-tamagawa-eco-fair-2026.access: About 15 min on foot from Musashi-Nitta Station (Tokyu Tamagawa Line).

edogawa-funabori-matsuri-2026.name: The 51st Funabori Festival (with a flea market)
edogawa-funabori-matsuri-2026.venue: Around Funabori Community Hall (plaza in front of Toei Funabori 1-chome Apartments)

edogawa-funabori-matsuri-2026.fee: 1,000 yen (collected in cash on the day)
edogawa-funabori-matsuri-2026.access: Funabori Community Hall is a 5 min walk from Funabori Station on the Toei Shinjuku Line. By Toei Bus it is a 4 min walk from either the Funabori 1-chome or Funabori-ekimae stop. The hall has only 5 parking spaces (including 1 for people with disabilities), and public transport is recommended.

shibuya-recycle-bazaar.name: Shibuya Ward Recycle Bazaar

katsushika-recycle-corner-flea.name: Katsushika Consumer Center Recycle Corner (held with a flea market)

katsushika-recycle-corner-flea.access: About 10 min on foot from Ohanajaya Station, or about 13 min on foot from Keisei Tateishi Station or Aoto Station (all Keisei Electric Railway).

taito-hanakawado-park-flea.name: Hanakawado Park Flea Market (Taito)
taito-hanakawado-park-flea.rule: Dates announced by Taito Ward (Sep 2026 – Mar 2027)
taito-hanakawado-park-flea.rain: Cancelled in rain, or when the organizing group decides on its own
taito-hanakawado-park-flea.apply: Differs by organizing group (for stalls and inquiries, contact each group; the Taito Ward page links to each group’s website)
taito-hanakawado-park-flea.access: About 3 min on foot from Asakusa Station (Tokyo Metro Ginza Line).

arakawa-park-flea-2027-03.name: Arakawa Flea Market (Arakawa Park, fiscal 2026, 2nd)

arakawa-park-flea-2027-03.access: 4 min walk from the Arakawa 2-chome or Arakawa Kuyakusho-mae stop (Toden Arakawa Line)

setagaya-soshigaya-furusato-festival-fle.name: The 28th Soshigaya Furusato Festival Flea Market

setagaya-soshigaya-furusato-festival-fle.notes: 28 stalls recruited. Residents of the Soshigaya area are given priority. Each stall is about 2 m × 2 m. Those in the business of selling goods are not allowed

setagaya-funabashi-fureai-matsuri-flea-2.name: The 37th Funabashi Fureai Festival Flea Market

Pickpocketing and bag theft are reported as frequent at the venue, so keep valuables safe. Buying counterfeit brand goods is a crime. naka-ikebukuro-park.name: Naka-Ikebukuro Park
naka-ikebukuro-park.access: Ikebukuro Station (JR, Tokyo Metro, Tobu Tojo Line, Seibu Ikebukuro Line)
naka-ikebukuro-park.summary: A park in Toshima City, managed by the Hareza Ikebukuro Area Management association as the designated manager.

hanakawado-park.name: Hanakawado Park
hanakawado-park.address: 1-14-15 Hanakawado and other lots, Taito-ku, Tokyo
hanakawado-park.access: About 3 min on foot from Asakusa Station (Tokyo Metro Ginza Line).

arakawa-park.name: Arakawa Park
arakawa-park.access: 4 min walk from the Arakawa 2-chome or Arakawa Kuyakusho-mae stop (Toden Arakawa Line)
arakawa-park.summary: A park in Arakawa City, also called the Ward Office Park, with a fountain at its center.

ukima-park.name: Ukima Park
ukima-park.address: 2 Ukima, Kita-ku and 2 Funado, Itabashi-ku, Tokyo
ukima-park.access: 1 min walk from Ukima-Funado Station (JR Saikyo Line)
ukima-park.summary: A Tokyo metropolitan park spanning Kita and Itabashi wards (per the Kita City guide).

akatsuka-park.name: Akatsuka Park
akatsuka-park.address: Takashimadaira 3-chome, Tokumaru 7-8-chome, Yotsuba 2-chome, Daimon, Akatsuka 4, 5 and 8-chome, Itabashi-ku, Tokyo
akatsuka-park.access: 8 min walk from Takashimadaira Station (I25, Toei Mita Line) / 1 min walk from the Akatsuka-koen bus stop (Kokusai Kogyo bus from Narimasu Station, bound for Takashimadaira Depot)
akatsuka-park.summary: A park presented by the Tokyo Metropolitan Park Association. Admission is free (some facilities charge a fee).

oshima-komatsugawa-park.name: Oshima Komatsugawa Park
oshima-komatsugawa-park.access: 3 min walk from Higashi-Ojima Station (Toei Shinjuku Line)
oshima-komatsugawa-park.summary: A park straddling Koto and Edogawa wards across the Old Nakagawa River. It serves as a disaster-prevention base and evacuation site in emergencies.

shinjuku-central-park.name: Shinjuku Central Park
shinjuku-central-park.access: about 10 min walk from Shinjuku Station (JR, Odakyu, Keio) / about 5 min walk from Nishi-Shinjuku Station (Marunouchi Line) / 0 min walk from Tochomae Station (Oedo Line)
shinjuku-central-park.summary: A park in Shinjuku City, with an area of 88,363.15 square meters.

nakano-central-park.name: Nakano Central Park
nakano-central-park.access: About 5 min on foot from the north exit of Nakano Station (JR), according to the Nakano Ward guide to Nakano Shikinomori Park.

kichijoji-parco.name: Kichijoji Parco
kichijoji-parco.access: 2 min walk from Kichijoji Station (JR Chuo/Sobu Line, Keio Inokashira Line)

zoshigaya-kishimojin.name: Zoshigaya Kishimojin
zoshigaya-kishimojin.access: 5 min walk from Exit 1 of Zoshigaya Station (Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line) / about 15 min from the east exit of Ikebukuro Station (JR) / about 15 min from Mejiro Station (JR)
zoshigaya-kishimojin.summary: A hall of Kishimojin, enshrined at a Nichiren-sect temple. It was designated a National Important Cultural Property in Heisei 28 (2016) (per the Toshima City guide).

ikegami-honmonji.name: Ikegami Honmonji Temple
ikegami-honmonji.access: 10 min walk from Ikegami Station (Tokyu Ikegami Line) / 12 min walk from the south exit of Nishi-Magome Station (Toei Asakusa Line) / bus (20 min) from Omori Station (JR Keihin-Tohoku Line) bound for Ikegami Station, get off at Honmonji-mae and walk 5 min
ikegami-honmonji.summary: A head temple of the Nichiren sect located in Ota City, Tokyo.

kibogaoka-park.name: Kibogaoka Park
kibogaoka-park.access: 20 min walk from Chitose-Funabashi Station (Odakyu Line; written "Oda Line" in the official text) / 20 min walk from Hachimanyama Station (Keio Line) / 4 min walk from the Funabashi Kibo Junior High School or Kibogaoka Danchi bus stop (Odakyu Bus / Keio Bus)
kibogaoka-park.summary: A park in Setagaya City. It opened in 1977 (Showa 52) and has a ball-game plaza and a wall-fountain plaza.

koushoji-yagoto.name: Koshoji Temple (Yagoto)
koushoji-yagoto.address: 78 Yagoto-honmachi, Showa Ward, Nagoya, Aichi Prefecture
koushoji-yagoto.access: By car: 300 m from the Yagoto intersection on National Route 153 toward Kawana. From the Yotsuya Exit of the Nagoya Expressway, turn right at the "Yotsuya-dori 3" intersection, go straight on Yamate-dori and turn right at the "Yagoto" intersection. Public transport information not confirmed on the official page (TBC)
koushoji-yagoto.summary: A Shingon temple. On the 5th and 13th of each month, stalls line the temple grounds, according to the city and the temple. On the 21st, the Kobo Daishi Zennen day, there is the "Koshoji Marche" (10:00–15:00).

arako-kannon.name: Arako Kannon Temple
arako-kannon.address: Miyamado 138, Arako-cho, Naka Ward, Nagoya, Aichi Prefecture
arako-kannon.access: About 500 m southwest of Arako Station on the Aonami Line
arako-kannon.summary: On the grounds of Arako Kannon Temple, the Arako Enku Market is held on the first Sunday of every month (closed in January (1) and February (2); a night market on 8/10, August 10). According to the city, organic vegetables, handmade shops and restaurants line up. According to the city's introduction, the temple is said to have been founded by Priest Taicho in 729 (Tenpyo 1).

nittaiji-kakuozan.name: Nittai-ji Temple (Kakuozan)
nittaiji-kakuozan.address: 〒464-0057 1-1 Hoocho, Chikusa Ward, Nagoya, Aichi Prefecture
nittaiji-kakuozan.access: About 15 min. walk from Kakuozan Station on the Higashiyama Subway Line, Exit 1. About 10 min. walk from the "Kakuozan" stop of Nagoya City Bus Kanayama Route 11 (Kanayama–Ikenoshita line) (about 30 min. from JR Kanayama Station)
nittaiji-kakuozan.summary: A Shingon temple. The 21st of each month, the monthly day of Kobo Daishi, is a Zennen day, and according to the Chikusa Ward official page, Zennen stalls are also held along the approach.
nittaiji-kakuozan.rules: On the 21st of each month (Zennen day), the approach becomes a pedestrian zone, so parking is prohibited from the approach to the temple grounds. Visitors coming by car should use the temporary parking (per the temple).

shitennoji.name: Shitennoji Temple
shitennoji.address: 〒543-0051 1-11-18 Shitennoji, Tennoji Ward, Osaka City, Osaka Prefecture
shitennoji.access: 12 min. walk north from Tennoji Station (JR Loop Line, Metro Midosuji and Tanimachi Lines). 5 min. walk south from Shitennoji-mae-Yuhigaoka Station
shitennoji.summary: A head temple of the Washu sect. At the Daishikai (the monthly day of Kobo Daishi) on the 21st of each month, stalls line the grounds, according to the official notice.

tsurumi-ryokuchi.name: Hanahaku Memorial Park Tsurumi Ryokuchi
tsurumi-ryokuchi.place: Outdoor annex exhibition space of Hanamizuki Hall (Mizu no Kan Hall)
tsurumi-ryokuchi.summary: An urban park in Tsurumi Ward, Osaka City. According to the official site, Hanamizuki Hall (Mizu no Kan Hall) can be used together with its outdoor annex exhibition space.

nagai-park.name: Nagai Park
nagai-park.address: 〒546-0034 1-1 Nagai Park, Higashisumiyoshi Ward, Osaka City, Osaka Prefecture
nagai-park.access: Right outside Exit 2 of Nagai Station on the Metro Midosuji Line
nagai-park.summary: An urban park in Higashisumiyoshi Ward, Osaka City. The official site announces the 4th Nagai Antique Market (Nomi-no-ichi) at the Southwest Plaza (11/21–11/23, 2026).

ikea-tsuruhama.name: IKEA Tsuruhama
ikea-tsuruhama.address: 〒551-0023 2-24-55 Tsurumachi, Taisho Ward, Osaka City, Osaka Prefecture
ikea-tsuruhama.access: IKEA shuttle bus (between IKEA Tsuruhama and Ohashi-bashi). Free parking, 2100 spaces (within business hours only)
ikea-tsuruhama.summary: An IKEA store. The store-event section of the official site lists "Loppis (flea market)".
